reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin whose primary purpose is notifying users about interaction requests, task completion, and errors through local, browser, and configured third-party messaging channels.

summaries.zh: 在任务需要交互、完成或出错时，通过系统、浏览器及飞书、企业微信、钉钉、Telegram和Discord发送通知提醒。
summaries.en: Sends notifications through system and browser alerts plus configured Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, Telegram, and Discord channels when tasks need interaction, complete, or fail.

capabilities: Sends task status, interaction, completion, and error notifications through OS and browser notifications
Sends notification payloads to configured Feishu, WeCom, Discord, DingTalk, and Telegram endpoints
Stores and uses configured webhook URLs, bot tokens, chat IDs, and signing secrets
Provides configurable notification triggers, throttling, deduplication, and message verbosity
